explanation: Four knobs shape every sinusoid. A is the amplitude (how tall above and below the midline). B sets the frequency — the period is 2π/B, so bigger B means tighter waves. C is the phase shift (slides the wave left/right) and D is the midline (slides it up/down). Watch the dot ride the wave as you tune them.
bullets: Amplitude A = half the peak-to-trough height.
C shifts horizontally; D is the midline the wave oscillates about.
